verdict.rationale: A public first-party GitHub repository (google/google-authenticator) exists. It contains one-time passcode generator implementations for several mobile platforms, supporting HOTP and TOTP, plus a related PAM module, so source can be read. However, no evidence names the license, and nothing shows the current app (with account sync and Privacy Screen) is the code published there. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented open-source license, evidence that the current shipping app's source is published, and independent corroboration.
